artifacts.purpose: Dependency-free single-source-of-truth model store with validation derivation and subscriptions

failure_modes: Deriving charts from stale control values

mechanism.summary: One model store accepts validated edits, derives all outputs from the same state, notifies every view, and provides reset without duplicating state in controls or visualizations.

record.notes: This package is intentionally model-agnostic; domain validity belongs in the supplied validate and derive functions.

rights.basis: Original implementation of a generalized editable-model contract. No source code or visual assets from referenced projects are stored.

record.selection_reason: Preserve one explicit model state across controls, simulation output and derived views so experimentation remains causally legible.
